item.name: 3. Fund the test account (manual step)
item.description: Run the SQL from 3.1 outside Postman, then verify with 3.2.

request.description:
The service has no deposit endpoint. Open the response's Visualize tab (or the Postman Console), copy the SQL and run it, e.g.

 docker compose exec postgres psql -U ledgerflow -d ledgerflow -c "<SQL>"

or paste it into Adminer (http://localhost:8081).

exec: const sql = "UPDATE accounts SET balance = 100.00 WHERE id = '" + pm.collectionVariables.get('aliceUsdId') + "';";

pm.visualizer.set('

{{sql}}
